authority_model.eligibility: derived from real factor definition, pre-final quality decision, frozen contract, and registered raw provider
authority_model.capability: family-scoped one-shot token with exact frozen scope
authority_model.outcome_computation: runner recomputes signals, returns, costs, and dependence-aware confidence bounds from bounded raw partition references
authority_model.terminality: exactly one immutable artifact or typed failure after outcome access
authority_model.decision_input: immutable final evidence view; no raw panel or caller-authored metric mapping

isolation_controls: final evaluation key excludes caller timestamps and mutable candidate hashes
changed scope cannot reopen a candidate family
physical, selection, and variant contamination are append-only taints
late taint is reflected by replayed selection assessment
discovery projections reject final-test authority events
raw artifact hashes are checked on append and chain verification

validation.command: python -m pytest -q agent/tests/alpha_quality/test_final_authority_v2.py agent/tests/alpha_quality/test_final_test_runner.py agent/tests/research_ledger agent/tests/contracts agent/tests/security agent/tests/acceptance agent/tests/performance/test_ags_acceptance_budget.py agent/tests/alpha_quality/test_feature_off_identity.py

validation.result: covered by the combined acceptance run

validation.command: python -m ruff format --check and python -m ruff check for Phase 10A files
git diff --check and execution-record JSON validation

red_team: same family cannot be reopened by changing freeze time or candidate hash
capability reissue and changed-scope access are rejected
caller-supplied precomputed final series is absent from the provider contract
interrupted access reconciles to a typed failure
late taint prevents promotion on replay
confidence lower bounds, rather than point estimates, govern scientific pass
legacy_policy: legacy final-test v1 remains readable for compatibility but cannot exceed research_only under v2 authority
known_unrelated_baseline_failure: test_tracked_release_manifest_matches_deterministic_rebuild reads user-owned problem.md and was reproduced before Phase 1
limitations: a pre-final research_only decision remains an immutable promotion ceiling even when final scientific evidence passes
registered raw providers are local bounded artifact descriptors; no network or live-market provider is introduced
the authority has no live-trading, broker, order, or production-readiness meaning
